text:
gabi: quick check on the new dark surface tokens. main asks: legend readability on tiny charts, code block font weight, and the theme switch label. attaching two compact mocks in Figma.

noah: lookin' good. tiny chart legends get lost at 240px width. the colored dots are too small and sit on #0b1218 which mutes them. suggest increasing dot stroke to 2px or adding a 1px halo (rgba 255,255,255,0.06).

sylvia: also the legend copy uses abbreviations: 'p50' and 'p99'. can we expand to 'p50 (median)' on hover or tooltip? non-ML PMs keep asking. small UX win.

aaron: accessibility: code blocks are set to font-weight 400 and SF Mono at 13px. contrast is OK but weight makes punctuation vanish. propose font-weight 500 for inline code and 600 for block code, keeps density without increasing bg.

gabi: nice. for token names, moving away from numbered tokens to semantic names would help: --surface, --surface-elevated, --info-600, --muted-text. ops wants this before release.

sylvia: chart palette suggestion: primary series -> #2fb7ff, secondary -> #ffb86b (warm), tertiary -> #b48df3. runs better through deuteranopia simulator. also add patterned fills for export to grayscale.

noah: copy nit on theme toggle: currently "Dark / Light". let's do "Theme: System / Light / Dark" same ask others had. also add tooltip "Follows OS setting when set to System".

design-bot: branch created: feat/legend-weighting-theme-copy. PR: https://git.redwood/console/pulls/419. automated contrast check: all inline code & legend text >= 4.5 except legend dots halo missing. Suggested CSS snippet:

```
--surface: #0b1218;
--surface-elevated: #0f1620;
--code-bg: #0f1722;
--code-text: #d2eaff;
--legend-halo: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
```

gabi: i'll update Figma and push the expanded legend hover copy. aaron please confirm font-weight change doesn't break line-height.

aaron: will test and post screenshots.

gabi: thanks everyone, targetting merge by EOD sprint cutoff. :rocket:
